title: Forget £870 Flip Flops, Jennifer Lawrence's Shoe Of The Summer Is This £40 Slide - NewsBreak
text:
By Daniel Rodgers ,
14 hours ago It was around this time last year when all anyone could talk about – or at least some people, online, for a couple of weeks – was a pair of flip-flops. Not because they were innovative in design, or because of the famous feet photographed with them on, but because they cost upwards of £600, and were from The Row. (Yes, for the price of a second-hand Ford Fiesta, you too could own a slab of rubber with a grosgrain strap.) The Dune sandals inspired the same reverence as all things Olsen-adjacent tend to now, but more often a kind of morbid fascination, or weary distaste at the spending habits of the ultra-rich.
